title: Supabase Management API logs.all removal
description: Supabase states that the Management API analytics/endpoints/logs.all endpoint is removed and directs callers to analytics/endpoints/logs.
oldBehavior: The application calls the analytics/endpoints/logs.all endpoint.
newBehavior: The application calls the analytics/endpoints/logs endpoint.
migrationInstructions: Replace a direct literal analytics/endpoints/logs.all path with analytics/endpoints/logs.
Review the ClickHouse SQL query shape required by the replacement endpoint.
